## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sectioned-by-Chapter Annotation of the Cāntóngqì*

by [陳致虛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E8%87%B4%E8%99%9B) (Chén Zhìxū, *hào* 上陽子 Shàngyángzǐ, *Lúlíng shānrén* 廬陵山人; fl. 1289–1335)

The classical Yuán-era *Cān tóng qì* commentary by **Chén Zhìxū**, with the canonical text re-divided into 35 named chapters (上篇 15 章, 中篇 15 章, 下篇 5 章) — the standard chapter-division for almost all subsequent recensions. Chén Zhìxū is the principal northern-southern-fusion commentator of the late Yuán; his *Cān tóng qì zhù* (preserved as DZ 1006 *Zhōu yì cān tóng qì fēn zhāng zhù*) is one of the most influential pre-Míng readings of the scripture. The DZJY recension here re-prints the canonical 35-chapter text, each chapter followed by Chén's running commentary in *Shàngyángzǐ yuē* 上陽子曰 form. The commentary is essentially complete textually but is here printed without separate preface or postface (the original Yuán self-preface preserved at DZ 1006 1.1a is omitted in DZJY). The chapter-titles — *Dà yì zǒng xù*, *Qián kūn shè wèi*, *Rì yuè xuán xiàng*, *Shèng rén shàng guān*, etc. — are Chén's own classification of the *Cān tóng qì* base text.

**Abstract**

Chén Zhìxū's *Cān tóng qì fēn zhāng zhù* is the standard Yuán recension of the alchemical canon, dividing the previously continuous text into 35 chapters with topical titles, a division that became normative in subsequent commentary. Chén is the principal Yuán *Quánzhēn* / *Nán zōng* fusion master, integrating Wáng Chóngyáng's northern Quánzhēn lineage with Bái Yùchán's southern *Nán zōng* alchemical theory. His broader project of *Cān tóng qì* / *Wù zhēn piān* harmonisation set the framework for all subsequent late-imperial inner-alchemy reception. For his life and broader work see [陳致虛](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E8%87%B4%E8%99%9B) and Boltz, *Survey*.

The **DZJY recension** of this commentary appears in juxtaposition with [KR5i0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0037) Zhū Yuányù's *Chǎn yōu* — the two together provide the editorial pair Yuán + early-Qīng on the *Cān tóng qì* in DZJY.
